newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse index pierces 1,600 pts led by banks.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse index pierces 1,600 pts led by banks.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange general index powered ahead, breaking the 1,600 level at open in heavy volume led by banks, brokers said.

"The general index has broken the 1,600 barrier with banks leading the charge on the upside," said a floor broker. "Sizeable cuts in lending and other types of interest rates have provided the fuel for the advance."
The general index was up 1.74 percent or 27.73 points at 1,623.27 points 12 minutes into the session. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
